title: 第二十一章 残暴下第二十二章 克莱利
lines: “莫奇刚刚说的，也算是对的，我们铬龙的战斗方式就是这样，贯穿、切割，因此显得比较残暴。”
西隆收回目光，缓缓的说：“另外，我之前也和你说过，其实我很喜欢这样狂烈战斗、熊熊燃烧的感觉，所以有时候会控制不住力度。”
“但这些其实都不是问题的关键，问题的关键，是你眼里的目标，和我眼里的目标，并不完全相同。”
西隆说：“你认为惩戒、警告、划清界限，做完这三件事就已经够了，但是因塔斯，我必须提醒你，有一个问题是需要你记住并思考的，那就是绝除后患。”
“绝除后患？”因塔斯一怔。
“是的，对待铁龙，我可以毫无顾忌的跟他们战斗，不用担心后果，哪怕决斗之后，也能跟他们正常对话，甚至成为朋友。”
“但是对待镍龙，完全就不是这个情况了。”
“你们不了解镍龙，但作为同族的我们却很清楚，镍龙是我们之中最弱小的，它们是最像色彩龙的重质龙，睚眦必报、阴狠恶毒。”
“镍龙或许会因为一件很小的事，对你产生很大的仇恨，这种仇恨也许会在你毫不知情的情况下，持续几百年，直到一个绝佳的机会到来时，才轰然爆发。”
“所以哪怕是在神陨浩劫的前提下，家族也不太喜欢镍龙，他们的数量在龙之谷里是最少的，并且不像我们一样各有来历可寻，龙蛋基本上都是冒险者和眷属供献给家族的。”
听到这样的话，因塔斯的神情微微一黯。
镍龙的身份来历令上位种鄙夷，次龙的来历却也是如此，龙之谷里阶级森严，能够决定话语权的，只有力量和血统。
他想了一会，回归正题：“既然是这样，岂不是不能轻易招惹镍龙？”
“在短命种看来确实是这样，不过同为重质龙，我们却是不怕的，你知道战斗的时候，我脑袋里在想什么吗？”
西隆微微凑近了因塔斯，脸上又再次出现了那种令人惊悸的神情：“铬龙的传承反复提醒我，要把他们全都杀了，才能绝除后患。”
“可这是家族严令禁止的罪行，如果同类相残致死，别说铬龙，就连铁龙也不能活命。”
说完西隆就坐了回去，身上那股气势还没升起，便松懈下来。
“所以我用了另一种方法，我不仅是要教训它们，我是要践踏它们。”
“我要让它们感到恐惧，给它们形成雏幼时期的阴影，让它们想到我的名字就害怕，连报复的心思都不敢升起。”
“镍龙是非常邪恶的重质龙，铬龙却是最大的邪恶，镍龙也许不会畏惧强大的善龙，但绝对会畏惧强大的铬龙。”
“因为我们不讲规则，而且说到做到，这就是我绝除后患的方法。”
“至于这东西……”
西隆把那块镍龙的头盖骨片掏出来，“吓唬他们而已啊，毕竟我又不是什么疯龙。”
他掂了掂骨片，使劲往湖面上一甩。
那骨片打着旋，斜斜地飞掠出去，在波光粼粼的湖面上，接二连三地弹跳，两下、三下……最后消失在视线尽头。
湖面上传来莫奇扑腾的水声，西隆抬起脖子，探头去看，对莫奇曳游的姿态指指点点。
content_en:
"What Mo Qi just said is correct. Our Chrome Dragon's fighting method is like this, penetrating and cutting, so it looks more brutal."
Shillong withdrew his gaze and said slowly: "In addition, I have told you before, in fact, I really like the feeling of such fierce fighting and burning, so sometimes I can't control the intensity."
"But these are actually not the key to the problem. The key to the problem is that the goal in your eyes and the goal in my eyes are not exactly the same."
Silong said: "You think that punishment, warning, and drawing boundaries are enough. But Intas, I must remind you that there is one issue that you need to remember and think about, and that is to eliminate future troubles."
"Eliminate future troubles?" Intas was startled.
"Yes, when it comes to iron dragons, I can fight them without any scruples. I don't have to worry about the consequences. Even after the duel, I can have normal conversations with them and even become friends."
“But with Nickel Dragon, that’s not the case at all.”
"You don't know the nickel dragons, but as members of the same race, we know very well that the nickel dragons are the weakest among us. They are the heavy dragons that are most like the chromatic dragons. They are retributive and vicious."
"Nickel Dragon may have a great hatred for you because of a small thing. This hatred may last for hundreds of years without your knowledge, until an excellent opportunity comes and explodes."
"So even under the premise of the catastrophe of the God's Fall, the family doesn't like nickel dragons very much. Their number is the smallest in Dragon Valley, and they don't have their own origins like us. Dragon eggs are basically donated to the family by adventurers and their families."
Hearing such words, Intas' expression darkened slightly.
The identity and origin of the Nickel Dragon made the superiors despise it, but the same was true for the origin of the Second Dragon. The hierarchy in Dragon Valley was strict, and only strength and bloodline could determine the right to speak.
He thought for a while and returned to the topic: "If that's the case, doesn't it mean that Nickel Dragon can't be easily provoked?"
"This is true from the perspective of short-lived species, but we are not afraid of heavy dragons. Do you know what was going on in my head during the battle?"
Shillong moved slightly closer to Intas, and the frightening look appeared on his face again: "The inheritance of the Chrome Dragon repeatedly reminded me that I must kill them all to eliminate future troubles."
"But this is a crime strictly prohibited by the family. If cannibalism leads to death, not to mention the chrome dragon, not even the iron dragon can survive."
After saying that, Shillong sat back and relaxed before the aura in his body rose.
"So I took another approach and I didn't just teach them a lesson, I trampled on them."
"I want to make them feel fear, give them the shadow of their childhood, make them afraid when they think of my name, and they will not even dare to think of revenge."
"The nickel dragon is a very evil heavy dragon, but the chromium dragon is the greatest evil. The nickel dragon may not be afraid of the powerful good dragon, but it will definitely be afraid of the powerful chromium dragon."
"Because we don't follow the rules and we do what we say. This is how I avoid future troubles."
"As for this thing..."
Shillong took out the skull piece of the nickel dragon and said, "I'm just scaring them. After all, I'm not a crazy dragon."
He weighed the bone fragments and threw them hard on the lake.
The bone fragments swirled, flew out diagonally, and bounced one after another on the sparkling lake, two times, three times... and finally disappeared from the end of sight.
The sound of Moqi's splashing water came from the lake. Shillong raised his neck, looked over, and pointed at Moqi's swimming posture.
